intro: Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron.

p: Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she has become one of the Crusade's foremost symbols through her absolute conviction, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.
